proposals.evidence_snippet: The Conference of Ministers of Education and Cultural Affairs recommends the modified Bavarian formula as a practical basis for converting examination results.
proposals.notes: KIT (a German university) page describing the KMK-recommended formula. Variables: Nmax = maximum grade, Nd = grade to convert, Nmin = lowest passing grade. Rounding rule not confirmed from an official HTML page (KMK primary text is a PDF); each university decides the final conversion.
